description: Find source pages that link to competitor targets but not excluded/user targets, then prioritize link-gap outreach and quality review. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

backlinks_status_type.description: Backlink lifecycle filter: live links only, lost links only, or all supported links. Type: String. Accepted values: "live", "all", "lost". Default: "live".

broken_only.description: Restrict results to backlinks associated with broken target pages when true. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

dofollow_only.description: Restrict results to followed backlinks when true; false does not apply that filter. Type: Boolean. Default: false.

exclude_internal_backlinks.description: Exclude links originating within the target’s own site when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

exclude_targets.description: Targets whose existing backlinks should be excluded from the candidate intersection set. Type: Array. Maximum: 5 items. Default: [].

items.description: One target whose existing link relationships should be excluded. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

include_indirect_links.description: Include backlinks that reach the target through supported indirect/redirect link relationships when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

include_subdomains.description: Include links or ranking data for subdomains of the target when true. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

internal_list_limit.description: Maximum embedded sample rows per aggregate record; this does not cap the aggregate backlink totals. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Default: 10.

limit.description: Maximum number of source-page backlink intersection records to return. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Default: 25.

max_spam_score.description: Maximum tolerated provider backlink spam score on a 0-100 scale; lower values are stricter. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 100. Optional; no client default.

min_domain_rank.description: Minimum referring-domain authority score on the provider score scale, not a search position. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 1000. Optional; no client default.

min_page_rank.description: Minimum referring-page authority score on the provider score scale, not a search position. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 1000. Optional; no client default.

min_rank.description: Minimum provider backlink authority score, not a Google search position; use the supported score scale and stated input bounds. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 1000. Optional; no client default.

offset.description: Zero-based result offset measured in rows; use with limit for pagination. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 20000. Default: 0.

rank_scale.description: Requested provider authority-score scale: one_hundred is 0-100; one_thousand is 0-1000. Individual filter input bounds still apply. Type: String. Accepted values: "one_hundred", "one_thousand". Default: "one_hundred".

sort_by.description: Metric used to order returned results; choose one of this tool’s accepted enum values. Type: String. Accepted values: "rank", "domain_rank", "page_rank", "first_seen", "last_seen". Default: "rank".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

targets.description: Domains, subdomains or URLs to compare; provide the target formats supported by this workflow. Type: Array. Minimum: 1 items. Maximum: 5 items. Required.

items.description: One domain, subdomain or absolute page URL included in the comparison. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.
